exec: An election authority reported a suspected attack on its website during voting; no impact is stated.
geo_basis: national commission headquarters (Putrajaya); Bernama gives only a Melaka dateline
plain: Malaysia's Election Commission said its website may be facing a cyberattack during early voting for a state election. Bernama says it is working with the communications regulator; no effect on the site was reported.
summary: Bernama reports that Malaysia's Election Commission said on 10 November, during early voting for the 16th Melaka State Election, that its website was believed to be facing a cyber attack threat. Chairman Ramlan Harun said he had yet to receive a full report and an official statement would follow. Bernama says the EC is working with MCMC; no impact is stated.
title: Malaysia Election Commission reports suspected cyberattack on its website during Melaka early voting

validation.note: Follow-up read Bernama (10 Nov 2026), which quotes EC chairman Ramlan Harun, so this is a 2026 event, not a recycled 2022 one; the SharkStriker tracker was removed. Malay Mail answered 403. Bernama states no impact; the official EC statement it promised was not found.

review.note: who said it: MCMC cooperation and report to authorities are Bernama's text, not the chairman's quote; summary now attributes; date, event and no-impact match Bernama

date_note: Bernama (10 Nov, 11:44) reports the EC announced the suspected attack earlier that day during early voting; the page gives no earlier day.
